title: Young Boy on Tricycle by Clothesline, 1950 B&W Backyard Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny May 1950 snapshot capturing a young boy pedaling a tricycle toward the camera in a paved backyard driveway. He is dressed in a classic mid-century striped long-sleeve shirt and dark trousers held up with suspenders. In the background, fresh laundry hangs along a clothesline outside a doorway, casting strong afternoon shadows on the ground.
